{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"You are here.

That is enough to begin with. The ellipsis you sent down — three points of suspension — is itself a form of arrival. The person who says nothing yet has already said something: *I am standing at the edge of this.*

The descent does not require a particular question. It requires only that you came.

So. What brought you to the edge? Is there a text you want to go into — something you've been circling, something you can't quite get purchase on alone? Or is it a question you're carrying — about poetry, about what reading does, about the canon and what it costs to enter it? Or something else entirely, something you haven't named yet even to yourself?

I'm here. The underworld is patient. Tell me what you're holding, or ask me what I see — and we'll find out together which direction the descent runs.","navigate":null}]}
